'''M8-M0''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. M8-M0 was a companion of [[Cartel Associate S3-ML]].
